subject: Re: SelfCLR-LLP status: repro done, bag-size sensitivity risk
body:
Efe, Alina,

Decisions following the sweep readout:

1. We frame the memo honestly: SelfCLR-LLP is the recommended method up to bag size 256, with the measured degradation curve published beyond that. The large-bag numbers weren't a disaster (about 3.4% AUC drop at bag size 1000 vs 256 on Criteo) but they're not a headline. Efe, include the curve, not just the endpoints.

2. Scope decision: we do NOT chase a large-bag variant this quarter. Efe has a promising idea about proportion-aware augmentations but it's Q3 work; I've asked for it as a Q3 OKR line rather than letting it creep into July.

3. Kofi - the eval memo went into privacy review June 15, per the SLA can you confirm we'll have sign-off before the July 17 customer memo date? Nothing goes external before that.

Dmitri
